title: Questions with To Be
summary: Invert am/is/are and the subject for yes/no questions. Wh- questions start with What, Where, Who, How, etc. + am/is/are
rule: Invert am/is/are and the subject for yes/no questions. Wh- questions start with What, Where, Who, How, etc. + am/is/are + subject.
examples: Where are you from? — I am from Brazil.
Is he your brother? — Yes, he is.

commonMistakes.explanation: Invert verb and subject in questions.

tutorHints: Practice inversion: You are → Are you?
